content.text: I'll verify the refactored modules still work correctly.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import ctypes, sys
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import netnomos.theory as th
print('theory imported; pandas loaded?', th.pd)
# check the dataframe path still works
from netnomos.dataset import PreparedDataset
from netnomos.specs import DatasetSpec, SourceSpec, SourceType, FieldSpec, ValueType
from netnomos.ast import Compare, SymbolRef, Constant
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
spec = DatasetSpec(name='x', source=SourceSpec(type=SourceType.CSV), fields=[])
df = pd.DataFrame({'a':[1,2,3],'b':[4,5,6]})
prep = PreparedDataset(spec, SourceType.CSV, df, {}, {}, {}, {}, [], {})
f = Compare('=', SymbolRef('a'), Constant(2))
print('df eval:', th.evaluate_formula_df(f, prep).tolist())
print('row eval:', th.evaluate_formula_row(f, {'a':2,'b':1}, {}))
print('pandas now loaded?', th.pd is not None)
PYEOF
